name: November 22, 2022 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  NOVEMBER 22, 2022
  TELECONFERENCED - VARIO US LOCATIONS
  9:00A.M.

The following meeting was held pnrsuant to AB 361 and fully teleconferenced from various
locations during the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Cherin called the meeting to order at 9:06 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance via teleconference by the Recording
  Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Lotte Cherin; Vice Chair Fireball Lawrence; and Commissioners Barry
  Haldeman (arrived at 9:08 a.m.) and Julia Holland

  ABSENT: Commissioner Peter Jones and Ex-Officio Graeme Clifford

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Acting Community Services Director; and Brittany
  Saleaumua, Administrative Assistant

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chair Cherin led the Pledge of Allegiance.

CITY OF MALIBU VISION STATEMENT

  None.

  At 9:08 a.m., Commissioner Haldeman joined the meeting.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  In response to Chair Cherin, Acting Community Services Director Riesgo stated Item No.
  5.A. included Commission accomplishments from July through December 2022.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Acting Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated the due date of the mid-year activity report was January 2023.

  Commissioner Haldeman suggested discussing Item No. 5.A. at the November 22, 2022
  Regular meeting and approving the report at the December 21, 2022 Special meeting.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of November 22, 2022
  Page 2 of 6

MOTION  Vice Chair Lawrence moved to cancel the December 21, 2022 Special meeting.

  The motion died due to a lack of a second.

  Chair Cherin stated the Commission selected the Special meeting on December 21, 2022
  at the October 25, 2022 Regular meeting. She stated she did not want to cancel the Special
  meeting on December 21, 2022.

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated he might not attend the December 21, 2022 Special meeting.

  In response to Chair Cherin, Acting Community Services Director Riesgo suggested the
  Commission discuss Item No. 5.A. at the November 22, 2022 Regular meeting.

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Haldeman seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0; Commissioner
  Jones absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the agenda for the meeting was properly
  posted on November 17, 2022.

ITEM I  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIO NS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  None.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  I.  Arts in Education

  Acting Community Services Director Riesgo stated she was working with
  the Poet Laureate Committee to schedule poetry workshops at Webster
  Elementary School, Malibu Elementary School, and Malibu High School.
  She stated teachers had submitted poems for the 2023 Student Anthology.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  Commissioner Holland stated the artwork for Music Inspired Art exhibition
  was selected, and the Ad Hoc planned to meet on November 29, 2022, to
  curate the show.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of November 22, 2022
  Page 3 of6

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Acting Community Services
  Director Riesgo stated the opening reception would be on December 4,
  2022, at noon. She stated A Call 2Peace Foundation would perform live
  music at the opening reception.

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated staff would install a Malibu City Gallery sign
  on the first-floor entry doors, and the Ad Hoc was discussing options for
  additional gallery signs. He stated an illustration by artist Russell Walks
  was the promotional piece for the Music Inspired Art exhibition, and the Ad
  Hoc was considering a single artist show with Mr. Walks.

  3.  Business and Community Outreach

  Commissioner Haldeman stated Malibu Chamber of Commerce Chief
  Executive Officer Barbara Bruderlin was working on the 2023 Malibu Arts
  Festival. He stated the Chamber of Commerce was planning an evening
  event to promote businesses and artists.

  4.  Social Media

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated information regarding the Music Inspired Art
  exhibition would be on social media.

  In response to Chair Cherin, Vice Chair Lawrence stated he was working
  with staff to tag and notify artists on social media.

  5.  Solstice Canyon Creek Beautification Project

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated the Ca!Trans Cooperative Agreement was
  under review and would be presented to City Council in January 2023.

ITEM3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Haldeman seconded a motion to approve
  the Consent Calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0;
  Commissioner Jones absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the October 25, 2022
  Malibu Arts Commission Regular meeting.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of November 22, 2022
  Page 4 of 6

ITEM4  OLD BUSINESS

  A.  Malibu Arts Center
  Recommended Action: Discuss ideas for an arts center in Malibu.

  Acting Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Chair Cherin suggested moving the question regarding Malibu residency to the
  beginning of the survey.

  Vice Chair Lawrence indicated agreement with Chair Cherin.

  Commissioner Holland stated the survey was seven pages, with multiple answers
  to some questions.

  Commissioner Haldeman commended Commissioner Holland for her work in
  compiling the survey. He suggested revising the question regarding age groups.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Acting Community Services Director
  Riesgo stated the Commission should determine when to release the survey. She
  stated the Commission would have an opportunity to discuss the results at a future
  meeting and determine a recommended action for City Council.

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated he would promote the Arts Center survey on Facebook.

  In response to Chair Cherin, Acting Community Services Director Riesgo stated
  the City would prepare a press release and marketing materials for the survey.

  Vice Chair Lawrence recommended adding the Commission logo to the survey.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Commissioner Holland stated the
  Commission could limit responses to one per IP address.

ITEMS  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Malibu Arts Commission Mid-Year Activity Report
  Recommended Action: Develop a list of the Commission's activities for the period
  of July through December 2022 to be included in the City Manager's Mid-Year
  Commission Activity Report, scheduled to be presented to the City Council at its
  Regular meeting on February 13, 2023.

  Acting Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Chair Cherin stated she had no changes for the mid-year commission activity report.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of November 22, 2022
  Page 5 of 6

  Commissioner Haldeman suggested revising the Malibu Chamber of Commerce
  item to state "The Art and Business Ad Hoc Committee met with the Malibu
  Chamber of Commerce to discuss opportunities to promote artists in local
  businesses, which has resulted in the formation of the Art Share Program and
  collaboration on upcoming community art events."

  The Commission indicated agreement and had no additional changes to the report.

MOTION  Chair Cherin moved, and Vice Chair Lawrence seconded a motion to approve the
  revised Malibu Arts Commission Mid-Year Activity Report with one revision,
  "The Art and Business Ad Hod Committee met with the Malibu Chamber of
  Commerce to discuss opportunities to promote artists in local businesses, which has
  resulted in the formation of the Art Share Program and collaboration on upcoming
  community art events." The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0;
  Commissioner Jones absent.

ITEM6  STAFF UPDATES

  Acting Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on Poet Laureate
  programs and the December 21, 2022 Special meeting.

ITEM7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Vice Chair Lawrence stated he viewed a documentary, 21 Miles in Malibu,
  produced by Michael Shane. He stated he would be a guest speaker at the Malibu
  Chamber of Commerce December meeting.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated his wife, Maureen Haldeman, was exhibiting her
  work at the Gloria Delson Contemporary Arts in Los Angeles.

  Commissioner Holland stated she visited Edward Hopper's New York exhibition at
  the Whitney Museum of American Art and Morris Hirshfield's work at the
  American Folk Art Museum.

  Chair Cherin stated she attended the opening of Omar by opera composer Rhiannon
  Giddens and toured the Santa Monica College satellite campus in Malibu.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Bergamot Station Liaison
  Art Donation Policy
  Chamber of Commerce Arts Report
  Crosswalk Art

ADJOURNMENT
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of November 22, 2022
  Page 6 of 6

MOTION  At 10:15 a.m., Chair Cherin moved, and Commissioner Haldeman seconded a
  motion to adjourn the meeting. The question was called, and the motion carried
  unanimously.

  Approved and adopted by the Malibu Arts
  Commission of the City of Malibu on December
